fields.acceptance: Tests in the new web package and internal/daemon cover the default 7787, a changed port, off, and that the listen address is always 127.0.0.1 (exercised through the handler and the computed address, binding no socket in the default test run); the daemon settings testscript lists rhiza.web.port with its default.
fields.statement: The running daemon serves the web UI over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 at the port rhiza.web.port names, 7787 by default, and serves nothing when it is set to off; rhiza daemon set validates the key and a running daemon picks up a change at its next poll.

fields.acceptance: A web package test compares /api/run.ls and /api/roadmap bodies against the api handlers' JSON for the same fixture repo, and a test walks the api registry asserting every allowlisted operation is a read and a write operation such as land, accept or daemon.set answers 404 or 405.
fields.statement: GET /api/<op> runs an allowlisted read-only internal/api operation with its request built from the query string and answers the same JSON bytes rhiza <cmd> --json prints; every other operation, and every non-GET method, is refused, so no write is reachable.

fields.acceptance: A web package test drives the events handler with a recorder, appends a log entry, a run journal move and an inbox item in a fixture repo, and reads one matching named event for each from the stream.
fields.statement: GET /events streams server-sent events naming what changed (a change set moved or landed, a run's journal moved, an inbox item arrived or left), so an open page knows to re-fetch.

fields.acceptance: A web package test GETs / and /static/app.js from the handler and gets a rendered page and the script with their content types; the Makefile and CI gain no Node or other build toolchain.
fields.statement: Pages are server-rendered from html/template files embedded with go:embed, with static assets (CSS, fonts, one small vanilla JS file) served from the binary under /static/, so the web UI needs no build step and no files on disk.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders a sample section with its event names and fragment URL, GETs the fragment URL and gets just that section's HTML; the script is served and names the stale state; no browser test.
fields.statement: A page section declares the events it listens to and a fragment URL; the embedded script subscribes to /events and re-fetches and swaps only the sections a matching event names, and marks the page stale while the stream is down.

fields.acceptance: The daemon status testscript shows the URL with the default port and shows off after rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.port off.
fields.statement: rhiza daemon status shows the web UI's URL (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) while the daemon serves it, or that the web UI is off.
